cohort: 657,968 women who delivered between 2008 and 2017 in Lombardy, Northern Italy
finding: Pregnancy associated cancer, especially when diagnosed during pregnancy, is associated with iatrogenic preterm delivery and some negative neonatal health indicators.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more common in women diagnosed with PAC during pregnancy (aPR=1.78, 95% CI: 1.49-2.11).
birth_weight: Lower in newborns of women with PAC diagnosed during pregnancy (p-value<0.001)
